title: Installments Already Lined Up for Collection When an Invoice Is Added
content:
Desk guidance for **Patient Payment Plans**: installments that are already lined up for collection keep the standing amount when an invoice is added to the plan and the installment is set anew.

## The rule

Where the next installment is already lined up for collection it keeps the standing amount:

- on a plan drawn automatically from a bank account, the next installment stays at the installment standing on the plan and the added-invoice installment applies from the one after it;
- on a plan without automatic payments on whose ledger a payment by check has been posted, the next two installments stay at the standing installment;
- on any other plan the added-invoice installment applies from the next installment.

In a re-spread the held installments are taken out of the amount spread at the standing installment and out of the installments counted; in a layering the balance of the added invoice is spread over the installments counted less the held installments, and the held installments keep the standing amount without anything being taken out of the added balance.

## Held installments by payment setup

| Payment setup on the plan | Payment by check on the plan ledger | Installments held at the standing amount |
|---|---|---|
| Automatic draws by bank transfer (ACH) | any | 1 |
| No automatic payments | Yes, at least one | 2 |
| No automatic payments | None | 0 |
| Automatic draws from a credit or debit card | any | 0 |

A *payment by check* is any payment on the plan ledger whose method is a check, whatever kind of payment it was.

## Hypothetical figures

Carried balance 960.00; balance of the added invoice 77.00 (together 1,037.00); standing installment 120.00; 7 installments in the spread.

| Held | Re-spread | New installment from the installment after those held |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1,037.00 divided by 7 | 148.14 |
| 1 | 1,037.00 less 120.00, that is 917.00, divided by 6 | 152.83 |
| 2 | 1,037.00 less 240.00, that is 797.00, divided by 5 | 159.40 |

In a layering with a standing installment of 140.00, an added balance of 300.00, 10 installments counted and 1 held: 300.00 divided by 9 is 33.333…, so the new installment is 140.00 plus 33.33, that is 173.33, and the held installment stays at 140.00.
